stories.headline: Massachusetts man indicted after arranging to pay for sex with a decoy 15-year-old
stories.summary: A federal grand jury in Worcester indicted a 39-year-old Marlborough man Sept. 3 on a charge of attempted sex trafficking of a minor.
stories.source: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Massachusetts
